schedule.notes: picked via smoke_test.py's LR sweep on real data (mps) at batch_size=32; candidates [0.0001, 0.0003, 0.0006, 0.001] over 50 steps each, min_lr = peak_lr / 10 (standard nanoGPT convention). See viva-lma.md for the sweep results.

batch_size_sweep.notes: picked via smoke_test.py's batch-size sweep on real data (mps); fastest candidate among [8, 16, 32, 64] whose fixed-2,000,000-token loss did not exceed batch_size=32's loss by more than 5%. See viva-lma.md for full reasoning.
